reader_summary.overview: And seemingly every new tool and data source makes the problem even worse, adding more complexity, more headcount, and more risk. Ridgeline offers a better way forward, one unified platform that automates away the complexity across portfolio accounting, reconciliation, reporting, trading compliance, and more all at scale. Hello and welcome everyone, I'm Patrick O'Shanasi and this is Invest Like The Best.

thesis: The core principles of entrepreneurship through acquisition remain relevant despite market changes, while the landscape has bifurcated into funded searchers targeting larger deals and self-funded entrepreneurs acquiring smaller businesses. Additionally, the SBA loan program enables buyers to leverage up to 80 or 90 percent to own significant equity without upfront capital, and the career path has shifted from being viewed as quirky to a more accepted route for diverse backgrounds.
